summary: Rename the storage-version, resource-protocol and wire crates to fractal-*

replay.detail: The rename changes source names only. Stored claims and projections do not change.

schema.detail: The storage version and schema digests stay unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and hash domains stay unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Rust callers use fractal-storage-version, fractal-resource-protocol and fractal-wire. The old Cargo names and dependency aliases are removed. Binary names and serialized values stay unchanged.

downtime.detail: The rename requires no state migration or service change.

manual.detail: Operators need no action. Source consumers update their Cargo dependencies and Rust import paths.

recovery.detail: Existing releases read the same state. Release notes still read storage versions from commits before the crate rename.
